CHAPTER 8 · ITEM 04 / 13

Tax revenue and deadweight loss

Calculating DWL計算無謂損失

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Identify deadweight loss (DWL) as the lost gains from trades no longer made. For linear curves and an interior equilibrium, calculate DWL = ½ × tax per unit × (Q before − Q after).

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

無謂損失來自稅令原本互利的交易消失。線性供需內部解下，三角形高為 t，底為減少的交易量。

DWL is the lost surplus from trades prevented by the tax. With linear supply and demand and an interior solution, it is the triangle with height t and base Q0−Qt.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：t=30, Q0=200, Qt=180. DWL=½×30×20=300. 單位稅乘減量再除二。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

t=4, Q0=100, Qt=80. DWL? 無謂損失？
